description: Documentation updates: add README section for skipped items (2FA, student accounts), add .env.example entries for new env vars (CRON_SECRET), and update README with new features. This FEAT is independent of all others and can be done any time after FEAT-001. Included last since it only documents what was built.
steps: Edit .env.example (or create if missing): add CRON_SECRET=<random-secret-for-cron-endpoint> under a new '# Cron endpoints' section.

Edit README.md (create if missing): add a '## New Features' section listing all 23 implemented improvements with one-line descriptions. Add a '## Security' section documenting skipped item 18: 'To enable 2FA for the admin account, go to Supabase dashboard → Authentication → MFA settings and enable TOTP. After enabling, scan the QR code in your authenticator app.' Add a note about item 20: 'Student accounts (item 20) are planned for a future release and require new auth flows not yet implemented.'

Edit README.md: add '## Database Migrations' section listing migrations 004–008 with their purpose and noting they should be applied via Supabase dashboard SQL editor or supabase db push in order: 004 (paper ratings), 005 (paper archive), 006 (activity log), 007 (scheduled publish), 008 (paper tags).
Edit README.md: add '## Environment Variables' section noting the new CRON_SECRET variable and how to generate it (openssl rand -hex 32).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors
npm run test:unit passes all 30 tests
README.md has Security section documenting 2FA setup
